content.title: AI Data Centers and the Need for More Electrons
content.description: Electricity demand is set to jump about 25% after years of stagnating as AI, data centers and electrification strain a grid built for slower times.The supply of energy might seem like it's on a collision course with the demand as President Trump seeks to boost fossil fuels and undo former President Biden's support for clean energy, but the markets show a different reality. We unpack why the US may need all forms of energy with BloombergNEF's Ethan Zindler, former Energy Secretary Dan Brouillette and Sunrun CEO Mary Powell.
